description: This file defines interfaces, classes, and structures related to message storage and metadata within the Thunder Core Messaging namespace, including event handling, message metadata, and various message info types.

classes.name: IEvent
classes.description: Interface for message events with serialization and data retrieval methods.

classes.name: Metadata
classes.description: Class storing message metadata including type, category, and module.

classes.name: IControl
classes.description: Interface for control elements with enable, destroy, and metadata retrieval functionalities.

classes.name: MessageInfo
classes.description: Class extending Metadata with timestamp and various specialized message info types.

classes.name: IStore
classes.description: Interface for message storage with methods to push messages and manage default behaviors.

methods.name: Metadata::Serialize
methods.description: Serializes Metadata object into a buffer.

methods.name: Metadata::Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes buffer into a Metadata object.

methods.name: IStore::Set
methods.description: Sets the singleton instance of IStore.
